cues.zh: 20 年前，我曾极力推广 JavaScript。
cues.en: 20 years ago, I was advocating for JavaScript.

cues.zh: 我当时的说辞是，JavaScript 远比大家想象的要好得多，
cues.en: My story was that JavaScript is a much better language than anybody knows

cues.zh: 只要用得好，我们就能做出惊人的成就，它甚至能改变世界，
cues.en: and that if we use it properly we can do amazing things about it and it can change the world

cues.zh: 而事实确实如此。
cues.en: and in fact that happened.

cues.zh: 但现在，我的布道观点变成了：
cues.en: But now my evangel is that

cues.zh: 我们应该停止使用 JavaScript。
cues.en: we should stop using JavaScript.

cues.zh: 它有着太多的先天缺陷，真的浑身都是“代码坏味道”。
cues.en: That it has so many congenital defects it really is a smelly language.

cues.zh: 里面充斥着大量的糟粕。
cues.en: There's a just a lot of crap in it.

cues.zh: 虽然就其应用领域而言，
cues.en: And it's still maybe for its field of application

cues.zh: 它可能依然是世界上做这类事情最好的语言，
cues.en: the best language in the world for doing that kind of stuff

cues.zh: 但这还远远不够。
cues.en: but that's not good enough.

cues.zh: 我们应该迈向下一代编程语言了。
cues.en: We should be moving on to the next generation of languages.

cues.zh: 过去，基本上每一代人都会迎来新的计算机语言。
cues.en: It used to be that we'd get new computer languages about every generation.

cues.zh: 我最开始用的是 Fortran，接着是 C，
cues.en: I started with Fortran and then C and

cues.zh: 然后是 C++、Java、JavaScript 等等，但之后这种迭代似乎就停滞了。
cues.en: C++ and Java and JavaScript and so on and then it kind of stopped.

cues.zh: 现在仍有人在开发新语言，但根本没人在乎。
cues.en: There are still people developing languages but nobody cares.

cues.zh: 一个人就能做出一门编程语言，而且是一门非常优秀的语言，
cues.en: One person can make a programming language, a really good one,

cues.zh: 但你根本推广不出去。
cues.en: but you can't get adoption for it.

cues.zh: 现在的 Web 运行方式有很多致命缺陷，
cues.en: There are lots of terrible mistakes in the way that the web works,

cues.zh: 操作系统也是如此，而我们却无法换上新的。
cues.en: in the way our operating systems work, and we can't get new ones.

cues.zh: 我们只能被困在这些垃圾里，看他们不断往上堆砌新功能，
cues.en: We're just stuck with this crap and they keep piling new features on everything

cues.zh: 而这些新功能又总是带来新问题，
cues.en: and the new features always create new problems and

cues.zh: 但本不必如此。我们本可以用上非常干净的操作系统、
cues.en: it doesn't have to be like that. We could be using really clean operating systems

cues.zh: 非常干净的语言和运行时，
cues.en: with really clean languages and really clean runtimes and doing all this stuff

cues.zh: 以更加可靠的方式来做这一切。
cues.en: in a much more reliable way.

cues.zh: 但我们似乎并不想这么做。
cues.en: But we don't seem to want to do that.

cues.zh: 我搞了整整一代人的 JavaScript。
cues.en: I've done JavaScript for a generation.

cues.zh: 是时候迎接下一个时代了。
cues.en: It's time for the next thing.

cues.zh: 我认为这不应该成为
cues.en: And I don't think that should be a

cues.zh: 这曾被视为激进观点，我认为它本该是正常的进化视角。
cues.en: considered a radical point of view. I think it should be a normal evolutionary view.
